categories.name: Food and beverage
categories.description: Food and Beverage & Prepared or made-to-order dishes and drinks ready to consume as served, including cooked meals, brewed or mixed drinks, and desserts; classified by the item itself, not where it was bought.

categories.name: Groceries
categories.description: Raw ingredients, fresh produce, and packaged food or beverage retail items, including dairy, meat, packaged snacks, condiments, and baking ingredients.

categories.name: Transportation
categories.description: Vehicle and movement-related expenses, including fuel, public transport, taxi, ride-hailing, parking, tolls, vehicle parts, and servicing such as repair and maintenance.

categories.name: Shopping
categories.description: Physical goods not covered by a more specific category, including clothing, electronics, household and cleaning items, toys, accessories, gifts, and gift cards.

categories.name: Entertainment
categories.description: Leisure and recreational activities, including movies, games and gaming accessories, streaming services, events, and hobbies.

categories.name: Health, Wellness and Personal Care
categories.description: Health and personal care expenses, including doctor and dental visits, pharmacy items, gym, salon, grooming, hygiene, and baby care products; excludes household cleaning products (see Shopping).

categories.name: Housing
categories.description: Costs directly related to housing and accommodation, including rent, home maintenance, and home services.

categories.name: Utilities
categories.description: Essential recurring services, including electricity, water, gas, internet, phone services, and postal delivery.

categories.name: Education
categories.description: Learning and education expenses, including tuition, training courses, and educational materials.

categories.name: Travel
categories.description: Travel and holiday-related expenses, including flights, hotels, and vacation bookings.

categories.name: Financial
categories.description: Financial obligations and services, including loan payments, interest, insurance, bank fees, and payment cards.

categories.name: Other
categories.description: Items that do not clearly fit any defined category, including unidentifiable items, internal codes, and items with insufficient information for classification.
